title: Bread and a Red Apple
description: In “The Girl Who Returned to School,” by the First Place Winner of the HerVoice 2026 Writing Contest, the writer recounts the story of a young Afghan girl who survives a brutal acid attack meant to silence her pursuit of education. Through memories of pain, perseverance, and hope, the piece explores the courage required to defy fear and continue learning in the face of violence. As the narrator grows into a teacher who secretly educates other girls, the story becomes a powerful tribute to resilience, resistance, and the enduring strength of Afghan women fighting for their right to learn.
from: National Society of High School Scholars (NSHSS)
